title: The leukemia study's depth settled
set_out: The leukemia study first, then the firm rate, then Met-A with the atlas as the ruler, then megakaryocytes and plasma, then replays if machines are free (author's order).

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: The C-Score's limits in the chain (GRP-019, DEV-CSCORE-LIMIT-01)
entries.what: Each C-Score reading now carries its healthy limit; on a 450K array the whole genome's limit carries the frozen platform term.
entries.outcome: Checked through the one command on a constructed 450K array; the reserved healthy bloods confirm next.

entries.title: The degron series: maintenance switched off over days (PHY-006, DEV-ERASE-01)
entries.what: Human cells with UHRF1 or DNMT1 removed: day 2 against day 0, region by region.
entries.outcome: Neither predicted answer in either line; the regions converge, as in the mouse test. IAM-A's baseline stays calibrated.

entries.title: The leukemia study at full depth, interim (GRP-020, DEV-ALL-INFO-01)
entries.what: 27 of the study's 31 leukemias, its cord-blood B-cell controls and the knockout, each read against its own molecules.
entries.outcome: Every leukemia reads above the highest control on IAM-A; the knockout reads furthest right.

open_at_turnover: Running on GitHub's machines: the last leukemias of the study at full depth and the degron series.
